title: Zigbee Sensor Low-Battery Roundup
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue events (`hue:event`), thermostats (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT bridged to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zigbee2mqtt:device
| stats latest(battery) as battery, max(_time) as last_seen by friendly_name
| where battery<20
| eval battery=battery."%"
| sort battery
description: Rounds up every Zigbee sensor whose battery is running low so you can replace them all in one trip instead of one dead sensor at a time.
value: Scattered battery warnings are easy to ignore until a critical door or leak sensor dies; a single roundup makes battery care a five-minute chore.
implementation: Bridge Zigbee2MQTT device reports to HEC; schedule daily and alert when any battery drops below 20 percent.
visualization: Table of sensors by battery percentage, sorted lowest first.
grandmaExplanation: It lists every wireless sensor with a low battery, so you can change them all at once before any stop working.
